views.title: Lifecycle overview
views.description: From incoming signup to approval, rejection, or manual review.

nodes.title: Receive signup
nodes.body: A signup request arrives from the public registration form.

nodes.title: Validate payload
nodes.body: Validate the payload and enrich it with account metadata.

nodes.title: Assess risk
nodes.body: Apply policy checks and route the request based on its risk score.

nodes.title: Manual review
nodes.body: An operator reviews the signup and records an explicit approval or denial.

nodes.title: Provision account
nodes.body: Create the workspace and send the confirmation email.

nodes.title: Reject signup
nodes.body: Decline the request and notify the user that more information is required.

scenarios.title: Happy path
scenarios.description: A clean signup moves straight through validation and approval.

steps.title: Accept and validate the request
steps.body: The runtime accepts the signup, validates the payload, and adds account context before any routing decisions happen.

steps.title: Apply automated checks
steps.body: Policy checks run on the normalized signup to determine whether the flow can stay fully automated.

steps.title: Provision the account
steps.body: Low-risk signups immediately provision a workspace and send the confirmation email.

scenarios.title: Manual review
scenarios.description: Risky signups branch into operator review before they can be approved.

steps.title: Run the initial validation
steps.body: The request still goes through the same intake and normalization path before any exception handling begins.

steps.title: Escalate to manual review
steps.body: Automated checks flag the signup, so the diagram branches into the operator review queue instead of provisioning immediately.

steps.title: Approve after inspection
steps.body: An operator signs off on the request, which reconnects the scenario to the standard provisioning path.

scenarios.title: Rejected path
scenarios.description: A risky signup is escalated and then denied during manual review.

steps.title: Validate the request
steps.body: The request enters the standard validation path before any manual handling begins.

steps.title: Route into manual review
steps.body: Risk checks flag the signup and send it to the operator review queue instead of auto-provisioning.

steps.title: Deny the signup
steps.body: The operator rejects the request and the runtime emits the denial outcome instead of provisioning an account.
